question_details.question: How many customers are there?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question_details.question: How many products are in the Books category?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Books'

question_details.question: How many orders were cancelled?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question_details.question: What is the name of the most expensive product?
question_details.sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question_details.question: What is the average product price?
question_details.sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question_details.question: How many customers live in Germany?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany'

question_details.question: Which cities in Japan have customers? List each city once.
question_details.sql: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers WHERE country = 'Japan'

question_details.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01'

question_details.question: How many customers signed up in 2023?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2023-%'

question_details.question: What is the total number of units sold, counting every order line?
question_details.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items

question_details.question: How many orders has customer 7 placed?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 7

question_details.question: Which product category has the highest average price?
question_details.sql: SELECT category FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC LIMIT 1

question_details.question: How many orders were delivered in March 2023?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND order_date LIKE '2023-03-%'

question_details.question: What is the cheapest product in the Electronics category?
question_details.sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

question_details.question: How many different customers have placed a returned order?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned'

question_details.question: Who are the 2 customers with the most orders? Give their names and order counts.
question_details.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.id LIMIT 2

question_details.question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders? Revenue is quantity times unit price.
question_details.sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question_details.question: What is the revenue for each product category? Show category and revenue, counting all orders.
question_details.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question_details.question: Which 5 products sold the most units? Show the product name and units.
question_details.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity) DESC, p.id LIMIT 5
question_details.answer: Result: [["Power Bank", 339], ["Python Basics", 333], ["Phone Stand", 327], ["Desk Lamp", 325], ["Space Atlas", 322]]

question_details.question: How many orders are there for each status?
question_details.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question_details.question: Which country has the most customers?
question_details.sql: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question_details.question: How many orders were placed by customers from India?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'India'

question_details.question: How many order lines does an order have on average?
question_details.sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question_details.question: Which month of 2024 had the most orders? Give it as YYYY-MM.
question_details.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2024-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question_details.question: How many customers have never had an order delivered?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered')

question_details.question: How many units of Sports products have been sold in total?
question_details.sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Sports'

question_details.question: Which customer spent the most on delivered orders? Give the name.
question_details.sql: SELECT c.name FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question_details.question: How many orders contain more than 3 different products?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 3)

question_details.question: What is the average order value, counting every order? Value is quantity times unit price.
question_details.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items

question_details.question: How many different customers have ordered a Yoga Mat?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Yoga Mat'

question_details.question: What percentage of orders were returned? Round to 2 decimals.
question_details.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'returned') / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders

question_details.question: What was the total revenue in 2024 from orders that were not cancelled?
question_details.sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01'

question_details.question: How many products cost more than 100 dollars?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price > 100

question_details.question: Which city has the most customers?
question_details.sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question_details.question: What is the name of the customer who signed up first?
question_details.sql: SELECT name FROM customers ORDER BY signup_date ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

question_details.question: What is the date of the most recent order?
question_details.sql: SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders

question_details.question: How many orders include more than 10 units in total?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 10)

question_details.question: How many products appear in more than 100 different orders?
question_details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT product_id FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 100)

question_details.question: How many orders are there for each customer country? Show country and count.
question_details.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

question_details.question: Among customers who have ordered, what is the average total revenue per customer?
question_details.sql: SELECT AVG(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS t FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id)
